items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I tried to get in Chuck Cabot’s band, you ever hear of him?

ctx.x: Was the Kenton band a band that you had aspired to be in? Or was it just an opportunity. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
Well I aspired to be in any band. Stan Kenton was great. I would have played with anybody. I mean I tried to get in Chuck Cabot’s band, you ever hear of him?
No that’s not a name I know.
